modelOverview: Introduced in 2009, the ref. 5116 revived the classic hobnail-bezel Calatrava design first seen in the 1980s, pairing a compact 36mm case with a grand feu enamel dial, Roman numerals and feuille hands. It is a manual-winding dress watch built around Patek Philippe's slim Calibre 215 PS. The line was offered in white gold from launch and later joined by a rose gold execution before being succeeded within the current catalogue by the enlarged 39mm ref. 6119.

5116G-001.movement: Manual winding · Patek Philippe Calibre 215 PS · 44h power reserve
5116G-001.bezel: 18k white gold hobnail (clou de Paris-style pyramid-textured) bezel
5116G-001.dial: White grand feu enamel dial with black Roman numerals and black steel feuille-shaped hands
5116G-001.description: The 5116G-001 is Patek Philippe's modern reprise of the archetypal hobnail-bezel Calatrava, distinguished by its white grand feu enamel dial, Roman numerals and hand-wound Calibre 215 PS movement. Its 36mm white gold case and slim proportions make it one of the most classically dress-oriented references in the current Calatrava family. Every example we offer is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.White Gold: 5116G-001 in 18k white gold with the signature hobnail bezel and white grand feu enamel dial with black Roman numerals, the reference's standard and most recognisable execution.
